title: Joshua Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on Joshua 7: the defeat at Ai, Achan's hidden plunder, and the valley of Achor.

questions.text: Who took some of the devoted things from Jericho?
questions.explanation: Achan the son of Carmi, of the tribe of Judah, took some of the devoted things, and Yahweh's anger burned against Israel.

questions.text: What did the men who spied out Ai advise Joshua to do?
questions.explanation: They told Joshua not to send all the people, but only about two or three thousand men, because there were only a few in Ai.

answers.text: Send the whole army against the city
Send only about two or three thousand men
Wait seven days before going up
Send the ark ahead of the army alone

questions.text: About how many Israelites did the men of Ai strike down?
questions.explanation: The men of Ai struck about thirty-six men and chased them from the gate to Shebarim.

questions.text: What did Joshua and the elders put on their heads after the defeat?
questions.explanation: Joshua tore his clothes and fell on his face before the ark until evening, and he and the elders put dust on their heads.

questions.text: What reason did Yahweh give Joshua for Israel's defeat?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said Israel had sinned and transgressed his covenant by taking some of the devoted things and putting them among their own stuff.

answers.text: Israel had sinned and taken some of the devoted things
Joshua had sent too few men to fight
The walls of Ai were too strong to take
The people had forgotten to shout aloud

questions.text: What was to happen to the man taken with the devoted thing?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he would be burned with fire, he and all that he had, because he had transgressed Yahweh's covenant.

answers.text: He would be sent out of the camp
He would have to pay back double
He would become a servant of the priests
He would be burned with fire, with all that he had

questions.text: Which tribe was selected when Israel was brought near by tribes?
questions.explanation: Joshua brought Israel near by their tribes, and the tribe of Judah was selected.

questions.text: What kind of robe did Achan see among the plunder?
questions.explanation: Achan said he saw a beautiful Babylonian robe, two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold, and he coveted them.

questions.text: Where had Achan hidden what he took?
questions.explanation: Achan said the things were hidden in the ground in the middle of his tent, with the silver under it, and the messengers found them there.

answers.text: Under a tree outside the camp of Israel
In a cave on the road to Ai
In his father's house in Judah
In the ground in the middle of his tent

questions.text: To which valley did Israel bring Achan and all that he had?
questions.explanation: Joshua and all Israel brought Achan and all he had up to the valley of Achor, and the place kept that name.
